scripts.lint: eslint app.js app/utils/ app/ui/ app/auth/ app/order/ app/report/
scripts.check: node --check app.js && for f in app/utils/*.js app/ui/*.js app/auth/*.js app/order/*.js app/report/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.deploy:hosting:fast: npm run build:hosting && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:hosting && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
